reason: Re-tracking a conversation after its tracked Work item is Done was a silent no-op: the Work page's Track posted request_id 'track:<session>' (a key per conversation) and Core returns a request ID's first item whatever its status, so Track returned the Done item, ignored the new title and the conversation still had no open item. Track now follows a deterministic chain: while Core returns a Done item it posts again with 'track:<session>:after:<done item id>' (at most 50 steps), so repeated clicks, other tabs and other clients reach the same open item and a finished item is never reused. Core's retry contract is unchanged (Work import reuses request IDs for Done items). Selected: WorkPage.test.tsx (its mock POST now follows Core's request-ID rule; the new re-track case fails on main; also covers another client tracking first) and the work-import real-Core browser journey, extended to finish the tracked item with a check-in and track the conversation again (one Done and one new In progress item, the Working-now link opens the new one). That spec was red on main and is repaired: 32+ character token (minimum since 2d9f099), Idempotency-Key on its API mutations (required since b833782), a readiness wait before the first mutation, and removal of Core's read-only retained release; the helpers are in the new shared ui/tests/fixtures/core-api.ts.
exclusions: No Python suites: Core code is unchanged. work-import runs three of its eight profiles (desktop 1440, Chromium 390, WebKit 390); the others are the same journey at other widths. The work-hub area also matches WorkPage* in playwright-impact.json but does not reach Track; it is extended in the separate blocker-status PR. No native code changed.
